snippet.title: Barely Developers Official Trailer | Game Dev Studio Simulator
snippet.description:
From the developer of Ultimate Theater Simulator comes Barely Developers, a first-person, co-op game development studio simulator!

Start in your mom's garage, create hit games, design your own gaming consoles, hire unpredictable employees, and grow your tiny indie studio into a AAA gaming empire.

Play solo or with up to 3 friends!

🎮 *Wishlist Barely Developers on Steam:*
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4431890/

*Coming Soon to Steam!*

Developed by RAKTWO Games.
